Drawback: Loss of Control.name: Drawback: Loss of Control
Drawback: Loss of Control.description:
🌪️ Push your Quirk and it pushes back.

⚠️ It spills wider than you aim and acts on its own.
⚠️ At the limit it runs wild for a moment.
🎬 Similar canon Quirk: Fumikage Tokoyami (Dark Shadow).
Drawback: Loss of Control.traitNarrativeEffects: Pushing the Quirk loosens the user's grip on it; strong emotion (rage, panic, grief) loosens it too. Quirk Strain 60 (50 for an Exceptional Quirk): the edges fray; effects spread wider or hit harder than aimed, and fine control becomes hard. Quirk Strain 80: the drawback is active; any use beyond light can overshoot and catch nearby people or property, and the narrator decides where the spill lands. Quirk Strain 100: the Quirk runs wild for a turn, acting on its own at full force against whatever is near, allies included; then it gives out until Strain falls below 60, and the user answers for what it did. Ordinary life: the user keeps calm on purpose, avoids using the Quirk in crowds or when upset, and may carry a past accident on their registration record. The signs fade as Strain falls back below each threshold. If the character chose Quirkless, this drawback does not apply: they have no Quirk and never gain Quirk Strain.
